name: @vaultkeep/desktop
description: VaultKeep desktop app (Electron) for macOS & Windows

scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/* dist/renderer/ && cp src/electron/preload.cjs dist/electron/

comment: Run `npm i -D electron` then `npm start` to launch the GUI. The app core + tests need no Electron.
